name: InfluxDB 2.0 Source
shortDescription: Periodically query InfluxDB 2.0 and publish the results to a Kafka topic.

Variables.Name: output
Variables.Description: This is the Kafka topic that will receive the query results

Variables.Name: task_interval
Variables.Description: Interval to run query. Must be within the InfluxDB notation; 1s, 1m, 1h, 1d, 1w, 1y

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB2_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: InfluxDB v2 connection details and admin token from a shared Variable Group.
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared InfluxDB v2 connection details, admin token and credentials.

Variables.Description: Base URL clients use to reach InfluxDB v2, including the http:// scheme and port
Admin token. Seeds server auth on first boot and authenticates clients
Organization the server is initialised with, and that clients query
Bucket the server is initialised with, and that clients read and write
Admin username the server is initialised with
Admin password the server is initialised with

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB_MEASUREMENT_NAME
Variables.Description: The InfluxDB measurement to read data from. If not specified, the name of the output topic will be used
